name: Soft Studio 3D
description: Low-poly 3D on a warm wooden desk: pastel objects against a soft wall with a window patch of sunlight, a desk lamp, books and a plant, one warm key light with a single soft shadow and a slow dolly. Calm, tidy, stylized product-photo feel. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-6 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with 1-3 desk objects: laptop, phone, monitor, coin (value = stack), chart, document, card, lightbulb. row compares, hero for one product. No emoji.
